title: Theophrastus as the first draft of Aristotle: the named-function model
description: These historical theses read the Platonic, Theophrastan and Aristotelian names as functions of one method: dramatizing, registering, organizing. The First Draft, The Registry Has One Column and Many and One argue that the Characters are the dialogue's material before theory, that irony runs the whole line, that the first axis of function-word variation is world/apparatus rather than author, and that succession is encoded as authorship. The Measurement Register and Locating the Dependencies add readings of Aristotle's absorbed Platonic operations and corrections to the Diogenes evidence.

The completion is not a designated receiver arriving but **a discovery about the instrument's range, made by continuing to operate it**.

claims.registered_title: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-NOTEBOOK-01)
claims.statement: **Provenance, as the heteronymic reading takes it:** Socrates died, and Plato killed him — the founder who wrote nothing is decommissioned into a corpus that speaks for him, with the author writing himself absent at the death (*Phaedo* 59b, **Πλάτων δὲ οἶμαι ἠσθένει**). Plato died for Aristotle to be born: the abandoned executions are left as holes with shapes, and the successor position supplies what crosses. On this reading succession is the **mechanism of the corpus**, not an accident of biography.

claims.registered_title: The Registry Has One Column: Theophrastus's Characters as a Named Authorial Function (v0.1)
claims.statement: Take the three modes not as authors but as operations indexed by names, each capable of recurring: the *Platonic* function dramatizes the problem in persons — scene, interlocutor, the definition sought; the *Theophrastan* function extracts, classifies, and registers — person and scene removed, type + definition + iterable deeds, the definition stated; the *Aristotelian* function organizes, explains, and architects — the type placed on a scale with its mean, cause, and exemplar, the definition explained.
claims.falsifier: A genre would show the same marks wherever the genre appears, under any name. An operation indexed by a name would show its marks against the *same genre under the other name*. The proper control is therefore not the Ethics but *Rhetoric* II 12–17: Aristotle's own sketches of ἤθη — the young, the old, those in their prime, the well-born, the rich, the powerful — catalogues of characteristic behavior, the same kind of thing the *Characters* are.
